description: Reads the training plan stored by set_plan (~/.suunto-mcp/plan.json). Local file only: never contacts Suunto, needs no Suunto credentials, writes nothing. Without `date`: { today, plan: { goal, start, end, updatedAt, phases, sessions: [{ date, title, hasGuide }] }, currentPhase (the phase containing today, or null), todaySession (today's session WITH its guide spec, or null), next7Days: [{ date, session: { date, title, hasGuide } | null }] } for the 7 days AFTER today (a null session is a rest day). With `date`: { today, goal, start, end, updatedAt, date, phase, session (that day's session with its guide, or null) }. No plan yet: { today, plan: null, note }. A damaged plan file is an error naming the file. To put a planned session on the watch, pass its `guide` to push_strength_guide (or several to push_week_plan): this tool pushes nothing. Read-only.

date.description: A single day to look up, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for the whole plan with today and the next 7 days.

name: get_plan
title: Get the training plan (today and the next 7 days)
